reason: User-controlled cookie value flows through URL decode -> Base64 encode/decode -> doSomething() -> concatenated into LDAP filter string (line 104-105) and written to response without proper filtering. The Base64 roundtrip does not sanitize input, allowing XSS/IDN injection.
